cohort: 82 term females admitted under the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology of the hospital nearing termination, comparing those who conceived after infertility treatments to those who conceived spontaneously.
finding: The rate of cesarean section was significantly higher in the group with a history of infertility (75%) compared to the spontaneous conception group (35.7%, p=0.038).
